name: Navneet Tripathi
summary: I'm Navneet Tripathi, an Information Technology undergraduate at SGSITS, Indore, focused on AI engineering, backend systems, and full-stack development. I build applications that connect secure APIs, reliable data systems, and intelligent workflows, taking ideas from an initial prototype to deployed software.
summary_details: My backend work includes FastAPI, Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, MySQL, and Redis, with experience in authentication, role-based access, caching, payments, and real-time communication. On the AI side, I develop agent workflows with LangGraph and LangChain, retrieval-augmented generation, MCP integrations, and tool calling. I also explore LLM evaluation, guardrails, observability, and the practical trade-offs between quality, latency, and cost.

My experience includes a software engineering internship focused on backend services and computer-vision research through an MPCST-funded project at SGSITS, using OpenCV and MediaPipe for real-time feedback. My projects include AutoBot, the SGSITS college platform, and EDU-AI. Alongside building, I continue strengthening my foundations in data structures, system design, and machine learning.
experience: MPCST-funded AI research at SGSITS · Software engineering internship
